newsitem.title: USA: American Biogenetic to market blood test.
newsitem.headline: American Biogenetic to market blood test.

text.p: American Biogenetic Sciences Inc said Tueday it had received clearance from the Food and Drug Administration to market a diagnostic test used to assess the risk of blood clots and to monitor anticoagulant therapy.
The non-invasive test, known as Thrombus Precursor Protein, measures soluble fibrin polymers that have been shown to be elevated in patients at risk of thrombosis.

Elevated soluble fibrin polymer levels have been identified with various clinical conditions, including myocardial infarction, deep vein thrombosis, disseminated intravascular coagulation, and in patients undergoing surgical procedures who are experiencing thrombotic complications.

American Biogenetic Chairman and Chief Executive Alfred Roach said in a statement that the FDA marketing clearance allows the company to move from a research and development organization to a commercial operating company with "near-term product sales potential."
